info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Business Analysi By Param1-spec
info.description: This API endpoint facilitates the update of specific business analysis data based on provided parameters. It allows consumers to modify existing channel portfolio information integral to banking operations. Typical use cases involve financial analysts and business managers who need to refine insights and adjust strategies based on new data inputs. Leveraging this endpoint enhances decision-making processes within the banking sector, ensuring that business analysis remains current and relevant.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific channel portfolio resource identified by its unique ID. Use this operation to make changes to the properties of the resource as needed.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary information to update the portfolio of channels for the specified business analysis resource identified by RES-100045. Ensure that all required fields are included in the schema to successfully modify the resource.
